# FieldSlate

FieldSlate is season-scheduling software for youth sports leagues: field-conflict
detection, interleague coordination, umpire assignments, and playoff brackets.
It is built for the volunteer admins who run Little League and other rec leagues,
and it stores no player or coach personal data — ever. Season scheduling only;
it is not a registration platform.
